value.description: ANSI output text. Supports SGR 16-color foregrounds, bold/reset, carriage-return rewrites, and erase-line sequences.

followLatest.description: Keeps the viewport anchored to the latest line while appending. Defaults to `true`; pass `false` when the host owns scroll position.

class.description: Additional class merged with the component's root class.

unsupportedProps.name: children
unsupportedProps.description: Rendered in place of the ANSI output when `value` is empty, e.g. an empty state.
